notes.title: Update 2.0 Coming Soon
notes.content:
Hi guys, I have came back from a hiatus from development. And I am proud to announce a new update that is coming in a few months. It is "Update 2.0". In this update, everything you know and love about this game will be revamped and made 100x better! Why are we taking a few months? We are reconstructing the game from the ground up, and we are adding a new campaign, more enemies and towers, better upgrades and progression, better optimisation and many more.

I can't wait to share more details of this update!

notes.title: OSX Crashes
notes.content: We are aware that some OSX users have been experiencing crashes when loading levels, to do with the screen resolution. This is something to do with the Mac Retina display scaling. We would request all mac users to please send error logs or any information with the crashes if they have them. It's also perfectly understandable if you want to request a refund due to those issues, however it would be better if you sent photos of the crashes so we can investigate.

notes.title: 1.3 is out!
notes.content:
Endless Defence 2 1.3 Patch Notes (10/8/2019)

Thank you for playing endless defence 2! For now, we have implemented a weapons system you can use to fire upon your enemies, and several new improvements, such as quality of life and 
balance changes. We have also completely rebuilt the four challenges (not bothered to write the changes down). Meanwhile enjoy the update.

BIG CHANGES:

With this patch, we have weapons in the game! For now, we have 5 weapons that are automatically unlocked!. To access these new weapons, go into options and select them. To use these 
weapons, press Q to switch modes from build to fight mode, and F to reload. Note that reloading costs money, and click at the enemies to fire upon them.

Featuring the:

Pistol - Slow fire rate, low damage, however very cheap cost for rounds.

Rifle - Medium fire rate, medium damage, great all rounder.

Sniper - Very slow fire rate, huge damage, expensive rounds. Good for accurate players.

SMG - Fast fire rate, medium damage, high dps. High cost for rounds.

Shotgun - Medium fire rate, high damage, expensive rounds.

As of any update, if you have any suggestions, remember to post them down in the community or youtube channel.

We have also rebuilt the challenges from the ground up. Enjoy the rebalances, however I wasn't bothered to write the full list of changes.

SMALL CHANGES:

- Added a speed adjustment button (or use 1 or 2 as hotkeys) to control the speed of the game
- Changed a few wave comments

REBALANCING:

TOWERS:

Money Pylon - Reduced upgrade cost from 8000/40000/80000 to 8000/24000/72000. Increased income generation from 100/300/900 to 140/450/1200 (BUFF) 
Missile Launcher - Decreased range of all levels from 45/68/140 to 30/67/90 (NERF)
Super Tower - Increased damage p/hit from 21/36/60 to 23/40/70
Machine Gun (L2) - Increased fire rate from 3 to 3.8. Damage p/hit increased from 121 to 130 (BUFF)

No enemy rebalancing for now. The enemies are fine.

Stay tuned for more updates, and join our discord if you havent yet. Trailers , new screenshots and other will be out soon.

- Endless Defence 2 team
